OSS consensus audit (2026-08-13): APPROVED investigation-and-optimization pattern; implementation must remain conditional on the profile's specific mechanism.

Git's own bulk-import backend consumes one mixed stream and writes packfiles/refs in bulk rather than invoking repository writes record-by-record (git/git@745601a, Documentation/git-fast-import.adoc#L14-L29). That supports amortizing redundant repository work, but not blindly replacing rebar's safety semantics with git fast-import. The accepted rebar contract on left-changeful-mamba remains controlling: N=3000, 6,000 events, exactly 24 crash-safe commits, >=10x reduction.

Tracker cross-check: left-changeful-mamba requires those exact assertions; no ticket rejected removing redundant scans/serialization inside the existing batch boundary. Proceed by profiling first, then implement only a narrow, measured bulk-path optimization that preserves crash-resume/rollback and all platform coverage. If the profile points to a semantic tradeoff rather than redundant work, stop and report it.
